run_preprocess_roberta_obfuscation: run the preprocess pipeline in obfuscation mode with roberta BPE tokenization for java and python
run_preprocess_fast_monolingual: run the preprocess pipeline in monolingual mode with fast BPE tokenization for java python and cpp
test_obfuscation_functions_pipeline: test the preprocess pipeline in obfuscation_functions mode with fast BPE and a custom codes and vocab path
count_bpe_lines: count the total number of lines across all .bpe and .bperob tokenized output files in the input path
check_number_lines_is: assert the counted BPE output lines are within a relative tolerance of an expected number
